summary: Concord Medical Services Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary Concord Healthcare Group Co., Ltd. saw the resignation of executive director Mr. Liang Chang effective May 11, 2026, due to personal career planning, and the election of employee director Ms. Li Jiang on the same day. The registrant is reviewing whether Concord Healthcare remains a consolidated subsidiary under applicable accounting standards. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisors are mentioned. The filing is a routine update on subsidiary board composition, not a forced departure, so it is classified as a low-confidence Management Change with the role of filer.
